item.title: Ministry Says 'No More Than 3 Subjects,' Imposes A-Level Cap After Pamushana Genius Scores 56 Points
item.description: Zimbabwe's Ministry of Education has imposed a strict cap on A-Level subjects, limiting students to three. This comes after Mukudzei Ziveyi scored 56 points across 12 exams in 2025. The ministry says the move aims to ensure "in-depth mastery" and prevent student burnout.

item.description: Zimbabwe's ministry of education refutes grade inflation claims after a student's record 56 points from 12 A-Level subjects, defending Zimsec's integrity while announcing a strict new subject cap.
